candidates.title: Card Selection Redesign for Path Choice
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a clear card layout showcasing available pet journey types.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a high mean time of 514 seconds, indicating decision hesitation.

guard.reason: Redesigns path choice screen while preserving both path options.

candidates.score_note: Targeted step drops 23.8% with high mean time, but evidence relies solely on funnel data.

candidates.title: Sign In Pet Cloud Persistence Guarantee Notice
candidates.change: Add an explicit data safety hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that pet progress persists to their cloud account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Your pet state is permanently saved to your account upon signing in.

guard.reason: Adds a valid data safety hint to the sign-in screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email evidence (8 complaints) solved cheaply with a copy/notice hint.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Trait Customizer Screen
candidates.change: Add a new customization preview screen before final certificate signing where users select pet personality traits.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 31.1% drop-off rate and 1017s mean duration, showing a need for higher engagement before certificate issuance.

new_pet_preview.headline: Preview Your Companion
new_pet_preview.body: Select starter personality traits and accessories.

guard.reason: Adds a valid customizer screen into the onboarding flow while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off rate (31.1%), but adding a whole new screen adds friction and high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Compact Layout for Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Reframe the adoption certificate step using a compact layout featuring a mascot image preview.
candidates.why: Simplify adoption finalization UI to address the 68.9% adoption conversion rate.

guard.reason: Removes the required official stamp component from the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.title: Estimated Render Time Indicator on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Display estimated render time and a visible progress bar during pet desktop initialization on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a mean time of 2336s and 3 users reported pets not showing up on the desktop.

waiting.hint: Preparing high-res desktop animations. Almost ready!

guard.reason: Adds valid progress and real wait time indicators to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) and user support complaints with feedback indicators.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Overlay Controls Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated overlay guide screen showing desktop keyboard shortcuts for hiding, summoning, and interacting with the pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails cited confusion about controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding.

new_desktop_overlay_guide.headline: Desktop Pet Shortcuts
new_desktop_overlay_guide.body: Press Alt+P to hide or summon your pet anytime on your screen.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new tutorial guide screen following home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Tackles highest drop-off step (35.2%) backed by support emails, but requires building a new interactive flow.

candidates.title: Instant Desktop Companion Prompt Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and button labels on the path selection screen to emphasize fast onboarding to a desktop pet.
candidates.why: Median time of 8s vs mean 514s suggests a long tail of hesitant users on choose_path.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Starter Bonus Badge
candidates.change: Display an exclusive starter item badge on the photo upload screen when creating a custom pet.
candidates.why: Support emails reported issues with custom pet generation; an incentive reduces drop-off during photo submission.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions an exclusive bonus/gift item.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Welcome Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home introduction screen into a full-bleed layout featuring an animated pet mascot welcome.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% (64.8% conversion) with high mean completion time.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the home_intro onboarding screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets 35.2% drop-off rate with visual redesign, but lacks support ticket evidence.

candidates.title: Sign In Desktop Readiness Notification Switch
candidates.change: Add a readiness notification toggle on the sign-in screen to alert users when their account sync finishes.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or not appearing.

sign_in.hint: We will notify you immediately once your account session is verified.

guard.reason: Adds a valid notification setting toggle to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets a minor drop-off step supported by 2 support emails.
